About Galleria
Located at the junction of Lang’ata and Magadi Roads, Karen, Galleria Shopping Mall brings together shopping, dining, entertainment and everyday services in one convenient destination.
With the opening of our New Wing, there is now even more to experience. With familiar favourites such as Carrefour, Panda Mart, Woolworths, Text Book Centre, Java and Artcaffé, alongside a growing collection of new fashion, lifestyle, home, beauty, dining and entertainment outlets.
Designed around open spaces, easy access and experiences for the whole family, Galleria continues to grow while keeping the relaxed and welcoming character our visitors know and love.

documents.title: About Galleria - Galleria Shopping Mall – Galleria Shopping Mall
documents.text:
Welcome to
Galleria Shopping Mall
Located at the junction of Lang’ata and Magadi Roads, Galleria Shopping Mall is a vibrant destination for shopping, dining, entertainment and everyday convenience.
Galleria brings together familiar favourites and a growing mix of fashion, lifestyle, home, beauty, technology, dining and service outlets across the mall.
At the heart of the experience is a welcoming indoor–outdoor piazza with dining, fountains, events and outdoor play. Family-friendly activities, convenient services, improved access and ample parking make it easy to enjoy more of your day at Galleria.
Whether you are running errands, meeting friends, enjoying a meal, attending an event or spending time with family, Galleria offers more ways to shop, connect and unwind.

documents.title: COURTESY POLICY
documents.text:
COURTESY POLICY
No smoking within and around the Mall except in the two designated smoking areas
No drinking for persons under the age of 18 in the Food Zone and other common areas. Management reserves the right to ask for an Identification Card.
We like your pets too! Please ensure leash always! Pick up their pressies!
No hawking/soliciting for any kind of business.
All vehicles are parked at the owner’s risk. The Management Shall not take liability for any loss or damage.
There will be mandatory security checks for all persons and/or vehicles entering into the mall
No photography or videography allowed within and around the premises without express permission from the Management.
Management reserves the right of admission into the premises.

documents.text:
Gift Vouchers
Gift Vouchers from Galleria Mall are a timeless gift, perfect for any Occassion. Gift Vouchers are available from our Management Office located on the first floor opposite Standard Chartered Bank.
The Management office is open Monday – Friday, 8:30 am – 5pm, Saturday 8:30 am – 1pm and closed Sundays and public holidays.

documents.title: Kids Activities - Galleria Shopping Mall – Galleria Shopping Mall
documents.text:
Shop, dine, play and fun activities
FOR THE LITTLE ONES
We have a lot of activities for the young ones. Our Kid’s Corner has fun areas like an indoor netted play area, with a cosy reading nook & art tables to doodle on! And is suitable for all kids including toddlers.
We also have fun and interactive events for the kids during the weekends. From a weekly Free Canvas painting to a monthly puppet show.
Bring the little ones along for some fun!
G Fun Club: Kids Play area
Our kid's play area has a lot of fun activities for the young ones like an indoor netted play area, with a cosy reading nook & art tables to doodle on! It is suitable for all kids including toddlers. Located in the middle of the food zone, surrounded by glass, where from the comfort of your lounge seat, your little ones are not far from your sight as you unwind while they play!

documents.title: Leasing
documents.text:
Leasing
We are conveniently located at the Junction of Magadi and Langata road, housing over 70 outlets of the most renowned brands  captured in a three-floored open-plan building design.
We also have exciting new developments such as The Galleria Gardens Business Center and its Residential Town Houses, that are among our endeavours to create and complete our unique mixed development masterplan. Galleria Shopping Mall is taking long strides to become your Unlimited Experience, join us in our journey.
Contact Us!

Parking Fees
How to pay for Parking
Ample and secure parking is available across Galleria, including outdoor parking and a shaded parking silo that has direct access to the New Wing from both levels.
Parking facilitated by Park-N-Go
Park-N-Go, is reckoned as the global market leader in access management and security solutions and visitor management, offering a broad range of innovative, customized systems enabling swift and secure access management of people and vehicles.
For enquiries or further details please contact Park N Go.

The published Galleria parking fees are:
• 0 – 15minutes: Ksh 50
• 15 – 30 minutes: Free
• 30 minutes – 2 hours: Ksh 50
• 2 – 3 hours: Ksh 100
• Any Additional hour or part of it: Ksh 100
• 8 pm to 6 am – Fixed Rate: Ksh 100
• Max Charge for a daily(24 hour) parking: Ksh 1000
• Lost ticket: Ksh 1000
The first two time bands are shown exactly as published and are unusual; confirm them with Park-N-Go.
Parking enquiries: Park-N-Go, 0790 856193. These are published rates, not a live tariff check.

For M-Pesa parking payment: scan the QR code on your parking ticket, review the bill, choose M-Pesa, confirm your phone number and complete the official payment prompt on your phone. The chatbot cannot collect payments or PINs. For help, contact Park-N-Go on 0790 856193.

I do not have verified parking entry and exit hours. The published night tariff covers 8 p.m.–6 a.m.; a tariff period does not confirm the parking gate schedule. Please confirm access hours with Park-N-Go on 0790 856193.

Ample and secure parking is available across Galleria, including outdoor parking and a shaded parking silo that has direct access to the New Wing from both levels.
For parking assistance, call Park-N-Go on 0790 856193.
Galleria’s published mall hours: Mon - Sun 8:00 am - 10:00 pm . Individual store hours differ. Tell me the store name if you need its hours; holiday changes should be confirmed with the store.

Gift Vouchers
Gift Vouchers from Galleria Mall are a timeless gift, perfect for any Occassion. Gift Vouchers are available from our Management Office located on the first floor opposite Standard Chartered Bank.
The Management office is open Monday – Friday, 8:30 am – 5pm, Saturday 8:30 am – 1pm and closed Sundays and public holidays.
Confirm voucher denominations and participating stores with management.

Galleria’s kids page describes the G-Fun Club play area, including an indoor netted area, a reading nook and art tables, suitable for children including toddlers. It is in the middle of the food zone. Confirm activity prices, age rules and dated events with Galleria before visiting.

For retail leasing, current space availability and a quotation, contact Galleria on 0704 498463 or info@galleria.co.ke. Galleria’s leasing page describes its retail spaces and the Galleria Gardens development.
Galleria’s courtesy policy welcomes pets, requires them to be kept on a leash and asks owners to clean up after them.
No smoking within and around the Mall except in the two designated smoking areas
No photography or videography allowed within and around the premises without express permission from the Management.
There will be mandatory security checks for all persons and/or vehicles entering into the mall
All vehicles are parked at the owner’s risk. The Management Shall not take liability for any loss or damage.
Galleria enquiries: 0704 498463 or 020 2363063. Email: info@galleria.co.ke. Address: junction of Lang’ata and Magadi Roads, Karen, Nairobi.

Galleria is at the junction of Lang’ata and Magadi Roads, Karen, Nairobi. From Nairobi town, the website lists route 24 towards Karen (Lang’ata Road entrance), or routes 125/126 towards Rongai/Kiserian (Magadi Road entrance). From Karen, use route 24 towards town; from Rongai/Kiserian, use 125/126 towards town. Ask to alight at Galleria. Check current routes and fares with the operator.
Galleria’s website lists 889 parking bays. This is published capacity, not a live count of available spaces.

Use Galleria’s mall map to view the mall layout. For a particular shop, tell me its name and I can check its published floor. Detailed step-by-step directions inside the mall should be confirmed at the information desk.

See Galleria’s official events page for dated event listings and booking details. I do not have a verified live event schedule or ticket availability, so please confirm dates with Galleria on 0704 498463.
See Galleria’s official deals page for published offers and their terms. Expired offers are not confirmation of a current discount; check the dates and confirm availability with the store.

Published notice-board advertising prices, inclusive of VAT: A5: Ksh 150; A4: Ksh 300; A3: Ksh 700; A2: Ksh 1600; A1: Ksh 2500. Confirm duration, availability and the current quote with the marketing team before booking.

The website lists flyer distribution at KSh 8,120 per day, inclusive of VAT. Only two people may distribute flyers; aggressive selling is not allowed, and booking and payment must be confirmed first. Confirm current availability and price with the marketing team.

Published in-mall activation rates per day, inclusive of VAT:
• Atrium A (243 Sq Ft): Kshs. 46,400
• Atrium A: Water Feature (243 Sq Ft): Kshs. 23,200
• Atrium B (162 Sq Ft): Kshs. 46,400
• Notice Board (70 Sq Ft) Essenza: Kshs. 23,200
• Notice Board (70 Sq Ft) Mr Price: Kshs. 23,200
• Star Optics (50 Sq Ft): Kshs. 15,080
• Woolworths / Bata (Water Feature) (50 Sq Ft Each): Kshs. 15,080
• ATRIUM A ENTRANCE (70Sq Ft): Kshs. 23,200
Confirm the current quote and space availability with marketing@galleria.co.ke or 0704 498463 before booking.

For advertising or in-mall activations, contact marketing@galleria.co.ke or eventsandpromotions@galleria.co.ke; phone 0704 498463. Notice-board, flyer and activation prices are published on the advertising page. Availability and the applicable rate need confirmation before booking.
